about: Initial MetaSoft BD discovery directory: well-known brands operating in Bangladesh, researched from their own public websites (and, for ownership, the parent company's own publications). None of these businesses has joined, endorsed, partnered with or been verified by MetaSoft BD. Imported by `php artisan platform:directory-import` (dry run unless --apply). Field meanings: database/sql/chunk70.sql.

listings.name: Aarong
listings.description: Lifestyle retailer of handcrafted clothing, home goods and accessories, run as a social enterprise of BRAC.
listings.ownership_note: aarong.com describes Aarong as “a BRAC social enterprise”; brac.net describes BRAC as a development organisation from Bangladesh.
listings.review_note: No Facebook link found on aarong.com; Facebook page left empty until confirmed.

listings.name: Yellow
listings.description: Clothing and home-textile retailer selling men’s, women’s and children’s wear and home items.
listings.ownership_note: The site names its operator as Yellow Clothing Ltd; no parent company is stated on the pages checked.

listings.name: Sailor
listings.description: Clothing and lifestyle brand selling through its official online store.
listings.ownership_note: The site calls itself “Sailor Bangladesh Official Store”; the owning company is not stated on the pages checked.

listings.name: Chaldal
listings.description: Online grocery shop with home delivery of food, personal care, baby and household products.

listings.name: Rokomari
listings.description: Online shop for books, electronics, gadgets, personal care and lifestyle products, delivering across Bangladesh.

listings.name: Pickaboo
listings.description: Online store for electronics, smartphones, cameras, kitchen appliances and accessories, with official warranty and EMI options.
listings.review_note: pickaboo.com links to two different Facebook pages (facebook.com/pickaboo and facebook.com/pickaboocom); left empty until the official one is confirmed.

listings.name: Daraz Bangladesh
listings.description: Online marketplace with cash on delivery across Bangladesh, part of Daraz, Alibaba Group’s South Asian e-commerce platform.
listings.ownership_note: Alibaba Group lists Daraz among its businesses as an e-commerce platform in South Asia.

listings.name: Shajgoj
listings.description: Online shop for authentic beauty products — makeup, skincare and haircare.

listings.name: PRAN
listings.description: Food and beverage brand whose range includes soft drinks, drinking water, flavoured drinks and juices.
listings.ownership_note: pranfoods.net and rflbd.com link to the same PRAN-RFL Facebook page; ownership is not stated on the pages checked.
listings.review_note: Facebook page is the shared PRAN-RFL group page.

listings.name: RFL
listings.description: RFL Group manufactures plastic, electronics, furniture and household products.
listings.review_note: Facebook page is the shared PRAN-RFL group page.

listings.name: Walton
listings.description: Manufacturer of electrical, electronics and IT products such as refrigerators, air conditioners, televisions, phones and laptops.

listings.name: Minister
listings.description: Home appliance brand of Minister Hi-Tech Park Limited.

listings.name: Singer Bangladesh
listings.description: Sells TVs, air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines and small appliances under the Singer, Beko and Hitachi names.
listings.ownership_note: Arçelik’s corporate history lists its 2019 acquisition of Singer Bangladesh.

listings.name: Bata Bangladesh
listings.description: Bata Shoe Company (Bangladesh) Limited sells footwear, bags and accessories, including Bata’s own labels.
listings.ownership_note: batabd.com: Bata began operating in Bangladesh in 1962 and is part of the Bata Shoe Organization, which operates in more than 56 countries.

listings.name: Apex
listings.description: Footwear manufacturer and exporter with its own retail stores in Bangladesh; its origins go back to Apex Tannery in 1976.
listings.ownership_note: Apex Footwear Limited’s About page gives its head office in Dhaka and factory in Gazipur.
listings.review_note: No Facebook link found on the official site.

listings.name: bKash
listings.description: Mobile financial service used for sending money, payments and other everyday transactions.
listings.ownership_note: bkash.com: a private limited company incorporated in Bangladesh, founded with BRAC Bank and US-based Money in Motion LLC as initial shareholders, later joined by international investors.

listings.name: Nagad
listings.description: Digital financial service with personal accounts, merchant services and a mobile app.

listings.name: Pathao
listings.description: Consumer super app founded in 2015, offering ride-hailing, food delivery, parcel and courier, e-commerce and payments.
listings.ownership_note: pathao.com says “Made with ♥ in Dhaka, Bangladesh” and that Pathao Ltd. owns its trademarks; ownership structure not stated.

listings.name: Shohoz
listings.description: Online booking platform for bus, train, flight and event tickets.

listings.name: 10 Minute School
listings.description: Online education platform offering classes and courses through its website, app and social media.

listings.name: Shikho
listings.description: Online learning platform for students from class 6 through SSC, HSC and university admission preparation.
listings.ownership_note: shikho.com’s press section presents Shikho as a Bangladeshi edtech startup.

listings.name: BRAC
listings.description: Development organisation from Bangladesh working to fight poverty and support education, health and social equality.
listings.ownership_note: brac.net: “a global development organisation from Bangladesh”.

listings.name: Grameenphone
listings.description: Mobile telecom operator providing voice and 4G internet services across Bangladesh.
listings.ownership_note: Grameenphone’s ownership page lists Telenor as majority shareholder alongside Grameen Telecom.

listings.name: Robi
listings.description: Mobile network operator (Robi Axiata) offering mobile voice, data and digital services.
listings.ownership_note: Robi’s investor relations page lists Axiata Group and Bharti Airtel as its main shareholders.

listings.name: Banglalink
listings.description: Mobile operator Banglalink Digital Communications Ltd., providing network and digital services across Bangladesh.
listings.ownership_note: VEON describes Banglalink as its Bangladesh subsidiary.

listings.name: foodpanda Bangladesh
listings.description: Food and grocery delivery platform ordering from restaurants and shops across Bangladesh.
listings.ownership_note: Delivery Hero lists foodpanda, including Bangladesh, among its brands.

listings.name: Kazi Farms
listings.description: Poultry and agribusiness group; Kazi Farms Limited began in 1996 as a hatchery and later started its own parent and grand-parent farms.
listings.ownership_note: kazifarms.com company background describes a Bangladeshi poultry company established in 1996.
listings.review_note: No Facebook link found on the official site.

listings.name: Akij Group
listings.description: Industrial group in Bangladesh.
listings.review_note: Official website not verified: www.akij.net (listed by Wikipedia) returned a certificate/privacy error and https://akij.net/ did not respond on 2026-10-20. Group businesses now publish under separate sites (e.g. akijresource.com, akijbashir.com); confirm which entity to list before publishing.

listings.name: Bashundhara Group
listings.description: Conglomerate that began in 1987 as a real estate venture; its businesses include real estate, paper, restaurants, media and sports.
listings.ownership_note: bashundharagroup.com: started in 1987 under East West Property Development (Pvt) Ltd.

listings.name: Bengal Group
listings.description: Bengal Group of Industries works in plastics and melamine, building materials, food processing, media, infrastructure, power and hospitality.
listings.ownership_note: bengalgroup.com describes itself as one of the leading conglomerates in Bangladesh.
